name: monochrome
title: Monochrome
description: Search Monochrome's lossless FLAC catalog, stream or download it through mpv, read its podcasts, and sign in to your account.
author: black

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Monochrome
commands.description: Search the catalog as you type, play or download a track, an album or a discography, read podcasts, and sign in.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: Control the shared mpv: pause, resume, skip, go back and stop.

preferences.name: player
preferences.title: Player
preferences.description: Player command used by Play. Leave empty to use mpv.

preferences.name: playerArgs
preferences.title: Player Arguments
preferences.description: Extra arguments for the player, split like a shell splits them. Leave empty for none.

preferences.name: playerWindow
preferences.title: Show the Player Window
preferences.label: Open mpv in its own window
preferences.description: Off: mpv plays headless. On: mpv opens a window with the cover. A running player restarts in the new mode on the next play.

preferences.name: downloadDir
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where Download and Download Discography save the FLAC files, one folder per artist.

preferences.name: podcastKey
preferences.title: PodcastIndex API Key
preferences.description: Monochrome's podcast tab reads PodcastIndex. Register a free key at podcastindex.org; the Podcasts category is empty without it.

preferences.name: podcastSecret
preferences.title: PodcastIndex API Secret
preferences.description: The secret that belongs to the API key above. Stored by Vicinae, never written anywhere else.
